name: Advanced Vocational Training Scheme
benefit:
> **Short-Term Skill Training:** 

- Training duration ranges from 1 week to 6 weeks.
- Courses are modular and industry-oriented.

> **Industry-Relevant Courses:**

- Training provided in emerging sectors such as:

  - Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
  - Cloud Computing
  - Cyber Security
  - CAD/CAM/CNC
  - Hydraulics and Pneumatics
  - Automobile Engineering
  - Welding Technology
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should have a minimum qualification of ITI, Diploma, or Engineering in the relevant trade or branch. 1. The applicant who is currently appearing in ITI/Diploma/Engineering may also apply. 1. The applicant may be an industrial worker, technician, supervisor, or engineer. 1. The applicant from government departments or the private sector with a technical qualification can apply. 1. The applicant from the public sector or private industry personnel may apply. 1. The applicant with experience in the relevant field may also take admission.
